svg.aria-label: What just dev does across a code reload. Kept: the SDL window, the vault unlock, saved settings and drafts. Rebuilt: the UI and the runtime, so transient dialogs and playback reset. The reload waits for active writes, open file pickers, staged attachments and message edits. A failed build leaves the current app running; a change to the C window host or the Rust library restarts the host while the vault stays unlocked.

g.text: failed build: the current app keeps running
C window host or Rust library changed: the host restarts, the vault stays unlocked
